name: Growing Up in a Flash
jem_summary: Grow a baby Strider into an adult using a Nether Caterpillar.

pages.title: Growing Up in a Flash
pages.text: Grow a baby Strider into an adult using a Nether Caterpillar.

pages.title: Growing Up in a Flash
pages.text: Prepare a new lava companion through real feeding rather than merely owning its food.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find a baby Strider or obtain one through ordinary breeding. Use a Nether Caterpillar on it: successful feeding consumes one caterpillar and immediately makes it an adult. An adult target does not qualify.

pages.title: Food for the Young
pages.text: A Nether Caterpillar instantly grows a baby Strider. The server consumes one caterpillar; an adult does not qualify. Obtain a baby through ordinary breeding rather than a spawn command.
